_comment: Weekly campus dining-hall menus, transcribed from Ville Dining's Sunday Instagram carousel (@ville_dining). Keyed by DIRECTORY PLACE SLUG under .places (upper-deck today; cove joins when they post one). Menus are subject to change without notice — this is a convenience mirror, not the source of truth. Maintained by the weekly 'Ville Dining menu sync' Cowork task (Sunday evenings) or hand-transcribed — never scraper-generated. CRLF.
_format: places.<slug>: { name, sourceLink (ALWAYS Ville Dining's Instagram PAGE https://www.instagram.com/ville_dining/ — the app's View Source button), postLink (the week's Instagram POST permalink — the sync task's dedupe key, never displayed), dateRange (human), validThrough (ISO date, EXCLUSIVE — the first ET day the block is stale; the app ignores the block on/after it, vfw.json convention), days: { 'YYYY-MM-DD' (ET): { brunch|breakfast|lunch|dinner: { '<Line label>': [items], ..., 'also': '<free text, e.g. Salad Bar | Healthy Bar | Dessert Bar>' } } } }. Meal keys are optional per day (Sat/Sun carry brunch + dinner only). Line labels render verbatim. Transcription is CORRECTED (obvious typos fixed), not verbatim. Validated in main.yml (syntax + shape).
